summary: 3 features and 2 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • frontend-config: add long-message collapse setting (cb82567)
  • localization: expose localized task and dungeon copy (dc00d4c)

HagiCode-org/web

  • confirm: add “don’t remind again” skip option (74a3e31)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • codebuddy: surface CLI failures and suppress replay duplicates (885f2bc)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: default Explore Mode off independently of executor (2499756)
